text: DSH Simple Worktree Plus 是面向 DSH Web 的 Git worktree 管理插件。它在新会话输入区、侧边栏和设置页加入创建与管理入口，并通过 DSH Workspace 和 Session 接口连接 Git 操作。用户可以从当前分支或默认主分支创建任务分支，在独立目录注册 Workspace 并打开新会话；也能跨 Workspace 扫描 worktree、查看分支状态、筛选和打开会话，或删除 worktree 并选择是否删除分支。适合按任务隔离代码工作区并集中整理分支的 DSH 用户。需要本机 Git 命令可用；代码未要求 API key 或外部账号。

DSH Simple Worktree Plus manages Git worktrees in DSH Web. Create task branches, register separate workspaces, and open sessions. Its panel scans worktrees, shows status, and supports reopening or removal with optional branch deletion. Git is required locally; no API key is needed.

@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus 的功能「创建任务 worktree」：从新会话区或管理入口打开创建框，输入任务名并选基础分支。插件创建分支和独立目录，将目录注册为 Workspace，再创建并打开会话。
@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus 的功能「管理 worktree」：从侧栏或设置页打开面板，扫描全部或指定 Workspace，查看状态并搜索分支和路径；可重开会话，或删除 worktree 并选择是否删除分支。
@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus 的功能「删除默认项」：在管理面板设置删除确认框的默认分支选项，偏好保存在浏览器本地，并用于之后打开的删除对话框。

@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus README · DSH Simple Worktree Plus：The Plus edition extends deletion policies, management entry points, and per-Workspace management for easier multi-branch task work and cleanup.

@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus
```

Restart `dsh web` and refresh the page after installation or upgrade.

@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus README · Usage：- Create a Worktree from a new session in a Git Workspace.
- Use **Worktree Management** in the sidebar to view Worktrees across all Workspaces.
- Right-click a Workspace and select **Worktree Management** to scan only that Workspace.
- When deleting a Worktree, use the confirmation options to delete its Git branch as well.

@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus README · Plus features：| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Branch handling on deletion | Optionally delete the corresponding Git branch when deleting a Worktree. |
| Delete branch by default | **Also delete the Git branch** is enabled by default. |
| Force-delete unmerged branches | Use `git branch -D` for unmerged branches; enabled by default and should be used carefully. |
| Top-bar entry | Opens Worktree Management beside the top Workspace picker. |
| Sidebar entry | Opens Worktree Management immediately above **Settings** in the sidebar. |
| Scoped Workspace management | Right-click a Workspace to open Worktree Management scoped to that Workspace only. |
| Deletion default preferences | Configure the default checkbox states used the next time a deletion dialog opens. |
| Independent plugin identity | Uses the `@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus` package and DSH plugin identity. |

@xzhi/dsh-simple-worktree-plus README · Warning：Force-deleting an unmerged Git branch permanently removes commits that are only on that local branch. Push, merge, or otherwise back up important work before deleting it.
